top_signals.title: EasyJet Profit Hit By Iran War as Apollo Takeover Looms
top_signals.summary: EasyJet Plc said the fallout from Middle East war eroded most of its profit in the fiscal year, with soaring fuel prices hitting the budget carrier as it prepares to be taken over by a US private equity firm early next year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Treasury yields fall as investors await key inflation signal
top_signals.summary: Bond yields moved lower Wednesday as investors awaited key inflation and spending data during a holiday-shortened week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: CTO of ‘RansomwareHelp’ Indicted for Wire Fraud
top_signals.summary: The chief technology officer and co-founder of ransomwarehelp.com, a six year old Florida business that claimed to use "advanced cryptographic tools" to restore data locked by ransomware, has been charged with wire fraud after an FBI sting operation found the company was simply paying the attackers for a decryption key and charging victims a markup for work that was never performed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Malaysia Says Too Early to See Impact of US Chip Curbs
top_signals.summary: Malaysian Investment Development Authority Chairman, and Senior Political Advisor to the Malaysian Prime Minister, Zafrul Aziz, believes it's too early to see the impact of US chip curbs. The US recently announced it would enforce tighter control on the exports of advanced artificial intelligence chips to Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia and Brazil. He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Heathrow third runway to stay on bills for 20 year
top_signals.summary: Passengers face paying higher fares to travel from Heathrow for the next 20 years, even if Andy Burnham abandons plans to build the third runway. Under fresh plans proposed by the aviation watchdog, the two firms bidding to manage the multi-billion-pound project will be allowed to recoup the roughly £400m associated with the planning process [...]
